notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native two-member exclusive Flush Queue timed-save case. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, interaction class and parameter names, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, a timestamped interaction at the save time 5 is delivered before an equal actual Flush Queue grant 5; the save remains pending. After the regulator advances, a later actual Flush Queue grant 6 initiates the constrained member's save before its grant callback. Both members complete the save. Direct traceability is limited to five pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.19, 4.19.6, and 4.20. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time using an adapter-supplied portable FOM. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. The per-recipient callback-service sequence is an experimental public observation, not a universal cross-service ordering, immediate-callback, transport, interoperability, or conformance claim.
